blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke chalti hui cheez mein ek aisi khoobi hoti hai jis ki wajah se woh har us cheez par force lagati hai jo use rokne ki koshish kare. Cheez jitni tez chal rahi ho, use rokna utna mushkil. Isi tarah agar do cheezen ek hi velocity se chal rahi hon to zyada mass wali (bhaari) ko rokna zyada mushkil hai. Newton ne is khoobi ko "quantity of motion" kaha. Ab ise linear momentum p⃗ kehte hain, aur is ki tareef yeh hai:

Yahan v mass m ki velocity hai. Is liye linear momentum vector quantity hai aur us ki simt wahi hai jo velocity ki. Momentum ka SI unit kilogram metre per second (kg m s⁻¹) hai; ise newton second (N s) bhi likh sakte hain.
Momentum aur Newton ka doosra qanoon (second law)
Mass m ka ek jism initial velocity v⃗i se chal raha hai. Us par bahar se force F⃗ waqt t tak lagti hai, jis ke baad us ki velocity v⃗f ho jati hai. Is force se paida hone wala acceleration:

Acceleration ki dono expressions barabar rakhein:
Yahan mv⃗i jism ka initial (shuru ka) momentum aur mv⃗f final (aakhri) momentum hai.

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Kitab mein do tasveeren hain: (a) paon se patthar ko thokar, jis mein raabta (contact) 1/100 second rehta hai; (b) football ko thokar, jis mein raabta 1/10 second rehta hai. Sochein: kis mein zyada chot lagegi, aur kyun?

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Kya chalti hui cheez mein impulse hota hai?

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Patthar wali thokar zyada dukhti hai. Momentum ki tabdeeli taqreeban ek jaisi ho to F = (momentum ki tabdeeli)/t; patthar par raabta ka waqt 10 guna kam hai, is liye paon par force taqreeban 10 guna zyada lagti hai. Aur chalti cheez ke paas momentum hota hai, impulse nahi; impulse tab hota hai jab force kuch waqt tak lag kar momentum badalti hai.

Equation (2.26) batati hai ke momentum ki tabdeeli = force × woh waqt jis tak force lagi. Doosre qanoon ki yeh shakal F⃗ = ma⃗ se zyada aam (general) hai, kyun ke is mein woh soorat bhi aa jati hai jab jism tez hote hue apna mass bhi badalta ho. Misal: rocket tez hote hue mass khota hai, kyun ke us ka fuel jal kar zor (thrust) dene ke liye bahar nikalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Aap ke baal khopri par crumple zone (takrao ka asar kam karne wali tah) ka kaam karte hain. Nangi khopri (cranium) taqreeban 5 N ki force se toot sakti hai, lekin jild (skin) aur baalon ke saath taqreeban 50 N chahiye.
Is liye doosra qanoon momentum ki zabaan mein yun bhi keh sakte hain:
Kisi jism ke momentum ke badalne ki raftar (time rate of change of momentum) lagayi gayi force ke barabar hoti hai.
Impulse

Kabhi force constant nahi hoti aur bohat thore waqt ke liye lagti hai. Misal: bat jab cricket ball ko marta hai to takrao ke dauran force har lamhe badalti hai. Aise mein force aur waqt ko alag alag dekhne ke bajaye un ka hasil-e-zarb (F⃗ × t) lena aasan hai. Waqt t tak lagne wali average force F aur t ka hasil-e-zarb impulse kehlata hai:

blocks.title: Example 2.6
blocks.problem: 1500 kg ki car ki velocity 3.0 s mein 20 m s⁻¹ se kam ho kar 15 m s⁻¹ reh jati hai. Rokne wali (retarding) average force kitni thi?
steps: F = -7500 kg m s⁻¹ / 3.0 s = -2500 kg m s⁻²
blocks.answer: F = -2500 N = -2.5 kN. Negative nishan batata hai ke force harkat ki ulti simt mein hai, yani rokne wali hai.

blocks.text: Momentum ke conservation (baqa) ka qanoon

Isolated system woh system hai jis par bahar se koi force na lage. Misal: constant temperature par sheeshe ke bartan mein band gas ke molecules. Molecules apni be-tarteeb (random) harkat ki wajah se aapas mein takrate hain, lekin bartan mein band hone ki wajah se koi bahar ki cheez un par force nahi laga sakti.

Ab do chikni (smooth), sakht gendon ka isolated system lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain. Dono ek hi seedhi lakeer mein ek hi simt mein v₁ aur v₂ velocities se chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain; takrao ke baad m₁ velocity v₁′ se aur m₂ velocity v₂′ se usi simt mein chalti hain (Fig. 2.9).

blocks.alt: Teen marhale, har ek neeche aur daen taraf. Pehle gendein m1 aur m2 velocities v1 aur v2 se daen taraf chalti hain. Phir gendein chhoti hain: m1 par force F' baen taraf aur m2 par F daen taraf. Aakhir mein woh velocities v'1 aur v'2 se daen taraf alag hoti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.9: Takrao se pehle, dauran aur baad do gendein (kitab ki Figure 2.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: m₁ ke momentum ki tabdeeli Eq. (2.27) se:
Isi tarah m₂ ke liye:
Dono ko jama karein:
Action force F⃗ aur reaction force F⃗′ barabar aur ulti hain (Newton ka teesra qanoon): F⃗′ = -F⃗, yani F⃗ + F⃗′ = 0. Is liye baen taraf zero hai:
Yani pehli gend ke momentum ki tabdeeli + doosri gend ke momentum ki tabdeeli = 0.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Chalti car achanak ruke to musafir windshield ki taraf aage jhuk jate hain. Seatbelt harkat ki forces ko badal kar musafiron ko aage jane se rokti hai, is liye chot ka khatra bohat kam ho jata hai.
Matlab: takrao se pehle system ka kul momentum takrao ke baad ke kul momentum ke barabar hai. Is liye do gendon wale isolated system ke kul momentum mein koi tabdeeli nahi hoti.

Aise kisi bhi group mein, agar ek cheez par force lage to usi group ki kisi doosri cheez par barabar aur ulti reaction force zaroor hogi. Nateeja: poore group ka kul momentum kabhi nahi badalta. Yahi momentum ke conservation ka qanoon hai:
Isolated system ka kul linear momentum constant rehta hai.
Yeh qanoon lagate waqt yaad rakhein ke momentum vector hai, is liye simt ka nishan (+ ya -) zaroor lagayein.

blocks.title: Example 2.7
blocks.problem: 2.0 kg aur 3.0 kg ki do gol gendein ek doosre ki taraf 6.0 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ ki velocities se aa rahi hain. Takrao ke baad bari gend ki velocity 3.0 m s⁻¹ ho to chhoti gend ki velocity kya hogi?
steps: Gendein aamne saamne aa rahi hain, is liye un ki velocities ke nishan ulte hain. 2 kg gend ki simt positive aur 3 kg gend ki negative lein.
Takrao se pehle momentum: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = 2 kg × 6 m s⁻¹ + 3 kg × (-4 m s⁻¹) = 12 kg m s⁻¹ - 12 kg m s⁻¹ = 0
Takrao ke baad momentum: m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′ = 2 kg × v₁′ + 3 kg × (-3 m s⁻¹)
Conservation se: pehle ka momentum = baad ka momentum, yani 0 = 2 kg × v₁′ - 9 kg m s⁻¹
blocks.answer: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹ (positive, yani chhoti gend apni pehli simt mein hi chalti rehti hai)

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Motorcycle ke safety helmet mein gaddi (padding) is liye hoti hai ke takrao ka waqt lamba ho jaye aur sakht chot na lage.

blocks.prompt: 20 g ki gend squash court ki deewar se 0.50 s tak 50 N ki constant force se takrati hai; impulse nikalein. Ek footballer 0.25 s tak 240 N ki average force lagata hai; momentum ki tabdeeli aur us ki simt batayein. Seatbelt aur helmet chot kyun kam karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Impulse = F × t = 50 N × 0.50 s = 25 N s (mass ki zaroorat nahi). Momentum ki tabdeeli = 240 N × 0.25 s = 60 N s = 60 kg m s⁻¹, us simt mein jis taraf force lagi (jahan thokar maari). Helmet ki gaddi aur seatbelt momentum badalne ka waqt lamba kar dete hain; momentum ki utni hi tabdeeli ke liye average force F = (mvf - mvi)/t kam ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: p⃗ = mv⃗ (kg m s⁻¹ = N s), vector. F⃗ × t = mv⃗f - mv⃗i: force = momentum badalne ki raftar (yeh shakal badalte mass par bhi lagti hai). Impulse = F × t = momentum ki tabdeeli (Example 2.6: -2.5 kN).
Conservation: isolated system mein F⃗′ = -F⃗, is liye m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′; kul linear momentum constant rehta hai (nishan ka khayal rakhein). Example 2.7: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹.
